findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_data_quality, get_rate_assumptions, get_export_manifest · Private data: get_platform_capabilities, get_fx_exposure, get_transaction_log_summary, get_overdue_drivers, get_export_manifest · Public sink: get_fx_exposure, get_hedge_portfolio, get_cashflow_forecast, get_rate_assumptions · Destructive: get_hedge_portfolio, get_protection_candidates, get_protection_builder_snapshot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_data_quality, get_rate_assumptions, get_export_manifest · Private data: get_platform_capabilities, get_fx_exposure, get_transaction_log_summary, get_overdue_drivers, get_export_manifest · Public sink: get_fx_exposure, get_hedge_portfolio, get_cashflow_forecast, get_rate_assumptions · Destructive: get_hedge_portfolio, get_protection_candidates, get_protection_builder_snapshot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
